items: Summary: Mark a slot to reduce incoming damage severity by one threshold.
When: Use after a hit and before marking HP when armor can help.
Not When: Do not reduce damage without spending a slot or feature.
Answer: It can reduce the severity of a hit.
Example: Khari marks Armor to turn Severe damage into Major.
